data.title: 阿蕾克希亚 · 小巷石阶的半块面包
data.description: 暮色笼罩的王都背街僻静石阶上。阿蕾克希亚把卫衣兜帽拉得低低的，小心翼翼地将热腾腾的红豆面包掰成两半，红着耳尖把较大的一半递到席德面前：“别误会，我只是吃不完而已。”
data.location: cobblestone alley staircase beside brick townhouse walls under lamplight
data.action: sitting on stone steps holding half of a steaming red bean bun outward toward the viewer, pulling down hoodie brim, blushing ear tips
data.lighting: warm golden streetlamp glow mixing with cool evening ambient shadows
data.mood: clandestine warmth, awkward honesty, humble everyday tenderness
data.promptProse: Alexia in a hoodie sits on cobblestone alley steps offering half of a steaming bread bun to the viewer with a stubborn blushing expression.
data.animaCaption: Alexia sharing a steaming red bean bun on quiet backstreet cobblestone stairs.
